problem: ATALA Prism and RootsID don't support zero-Knowledge Proofs and Predicates and are currently not interoperable with Hyperledger Aries or W3C OBv3. Prism is only on Testnet. Let's get ATALA on Mainnet.
solution: Build zero-Knowledge Proof and Predicate integration layer for ATALA Prism on RootsID CLI-WAL wallet and make them interoperable with Hyperledger Aries and W3C OBv3.
title: ATALA Prism zKP + Hyperledger Aries

problem: Cardano needs to simplify its user experience. There are too many cluttered dApps, wallets and data feeds. Users need a simple, elegant, data aggregator for all things Cardano.
solution: We are building a dashboard to display all your wallet and DeFi information in one clean, simple interface. Aggregating marketplace data to allow a holistic view of your decentralized life.
title: Atrium - The Center of Everything

problem: How do we get the interest of artists & developers planning to release NFT projects on ETH and onboard them smoothly to Cardano?
solution: One-on-one consultancy & onboarding sessions for new & in-development ETH NFT projects supported by a series of comprehensive & appealing visual guides.
title: Attract ETH NFT Projects & Talent

problem: Developers are unaware of the possibility of being remunerated by a decentralized fund. Besides, they are not being motivated to engage in an ecosystem where their code can also have social impact.
solution: Developing content tailored to introduce new LATAM developers to Cardano and to encourage engagement through group mentoring and community activities such as project development.
title: Attracting New Developers

problem: Double-satisfaction bugs, clone script attacks – the same vulnerabilities repeat in Plutus contracts. We will build a tool that automatically finds subtle instances of common bugs.
solution: We have already built Yogo, a semantic search and bug-finding tool for C, Java, and Python based on automated reasoning techniques, published in PLDI 2020. We will add Haskell/Plutus support.
title: Automated Bug-finding for Plutus

problem: When a new version of the Cardano node is released, it is difficult for community members to run basic functional tests on the node in an automated fashion (e.g., transactions, stake pool operation).
solution: We propose to provide a CI/CD pipeline using Gitlab runners and the Cardano-Tools Python library to develop a suite of tests capable of continuously testing the Cardano node's core functionality.
title: Automated Cardano Testing Pipeline

problem: Funded projects currently lack the tools to support financial Implementations. Each project has a different tool and executes in a different way. These tools are often used manually by project manager
solution: This proposal aims to build a smart contract to automatically disburse amongst wallets of project members. dApp is designed to send ADA under certain pre-set conditions.
title: Automated funding 4 funded projects

problem: For the Iagon token bridge, the current process has to be split into two manual steps (instead of automatic): Ethereum to Milkomeda and Milkomeda to Cardano, which is not an ideal user experience.
solution: Currently, moving tokens between Ethereum and Cardano involves two steps. Further development leading to automation of the process would enhance the user journey and open the bridge to more tokens.
title: Automatic cross-chain token bridge

problem: Cardano DEXs currently use ‘batching’ transactions to allow reasonable throughput. These transaction batching solutions introduce latency and extractable value problems. We can do better.
solution: Bashoswap takes advantage of the EUTXO ledger design built into the Cardano network to allow rapid, non-batched transactions with improved trust and reduced latency.
title: Bashoswap - non-batching AMM DEX

problem: The traditional relationship between game developers and players is one-sided.  There needs to be more legitimate benefits for players.
solution: Through NFTs and blockchain technology we will offer an opportunity for game users to earn real money for doing something they enjoy.
title: Battle Borgz P2E Game - Phase 2

problem: People experiencing homelessness are stereotyped, stigmatized, and face uphill battles gaining stable housing; while Cardano needs streaming content that matches the empathy and love of its community.
solution: We'll make an engaging Cardano-based reality tv show, that humanizes and encourages the contestants as they dig deep to complete challenges. The pilot episode is in Chicago, and will expand worldwide.
title: Be Love ❤️

problem: Not just real gamers hate on-chained games, but we also have no sustainable, long-term way to attract - educate - convince them to try our good games.
solution: Miverse provides a comic platform and produces a comic - one of the ultimate weapons to attract real gamers on-chained. In long term, authors can monetize their dream here.
title: BEST WAY TO ATTRACT REAL GAMERS

problem: There is a need in our ecosystem for a project that offers clear data about the Cardano's blockchain health and growth, benefiting a wide array of people, from investors to dApp developers.
solution: A tool to help users understand the blockchain by exposing its network effects, feeding investor analysis, and serving educational content.
title: Better Cardano Blockchain Insights

problem: Proposals are currently walls of text that most people don’t want to read.
solution: Introduce easy-to-build visualizations and quantifiable metrics to supplement/replace most of the text of a proposal.
title: Beyond Text Proposals

problem: The Cardano ecosystem has avenues of having e-commerce platforms associated to the blockchain. An incentivizing factor which drives individuals to use ADA pay or e-commerce sites on these platforms.
solution: Users will be able to buy products and services through an app & receive cashback on our native $bucs token . The tokens can be staked for passive rewards and used for buying products as well.
title: BigBucs- Crypto Cashback Platform

problem: Many projects developing in the NFT space lack a utility that can connect to the traditional world and the world becoming more digital means a need for bridging that gap is arising in many forms.
solution: We are designing digital aquariums that collectors can customize with their own NFTs (of any project) including from other chains. We already have support for Cardano and Ethereum NFT wallets.
title: BitFins Cross-Chain NFT Aquariums

problem: Young black entrepreneurs get less business funding than their counterparts. Lack of opportunity for these groups is problematic. Project Catalyst is a great way for Black PhD’s to grow businesses.
solution: Cardano’s philosophy is well rooted in research. There are thousands of talented PhD research students globally! Black and PhD is a network of black PhD students globally, with 900 followers already.
title: Black & PhD: Writing retreat for PC

problem: I don't want to die in war, I don't want to be a slave, I don't want to live in poverty, I don't want to endure deception.
solution: I will create an environment to bring together people who want to build a new decentralized society that eliminates social inequality, cares for nature, and lives in well-being, sanity, and unity.
title: BLAGO - Global Paradigm Shift

problem: The majority of developers in Vietnam are not familiar with blockchain or are not right understand of blockchain and its importance roles to the real world.
solution: Organize short training courses for developers in Vietnam to help them have the right knowledge about blockchain technology and its application in life.
title: Blockchain Course for Vietnam Devs

problem: Education is key to adoption and use of a service. How can we educate students in Northern Ghana and beyond about Cardano Ecosystem and its benefits?
solution: Organize both online and face-to-face community events to educate young tertiary and high school students about cardano ecosystem and its benefits.
title: Blockchain Education Masterclass

problem: Limited education and propagation of the blockchain industry as a long-term investment option amongst the youth in Ghana.
solution: Develop an educational dApp with concise and interactive lessons on blockchain for beginners to easily understand. These topics are chosen by the user and consumed in bite-sizes to avert confusion.
title: Blockchain Educational dApp

Migrate storing paper original contract copies in safes to storing digital contracts on Cardano blockchain.

  


Blockchain is a single verifiable copy of the contract accessible by all interested parties
title: Blockchain for Contracts: Indonesia

challenge: F9: Grow East Asia, Grow Cardano
problem: There are very few videos about blockchain technology knowledge in Vietnamese. This makes a lot of investors in Vietnam not really understand the technology of blockchain and Cardano.
solution:
We will create Cardano and Blockchain knowledge videos in Vietnamese

We will be sharing these videos with Cardano Communities in Vietnam

These videos will help the community better understand Cardano

solution: We will make use of Cardano metadata & wallets to allow any ADA wallet to create or respond to a questionnaire on the blockchain. Poll creators can segment, filter, interpret, & display results.
title: Blockchain Surveys for DAOs & More

solution: We propose to create a verified blueprint of how to set up an investment fund to manage money for up to 50 individuals in compliance with KYC and AML regulations for a $30k setup fee and $10k annual
title: Blueprint for Investment Funds

title: Bonding native assets to NFTs

problem: The evolution of the Cardano ecosystem and the project catalyst in the African region is moderate but is barely adopted in South Africa. Thus, it requires boosting.
solution: Boost the adoption of Cardano and Project Catalyst through a grand outreach event for university students, developers, and business personnel in South Africa 🇿🇦.

solution: Structure a DAO to promote rewards to help our community get involved in simple tasks and develop small projects to improve governance, thus developing a vision for this DAO.
title: Brazilian Community DAO

solution: We aim to create a scalable protocol that can be used to trade assets between Cardano and other blockchains, not based on a bridge. This can be realized in multiple variants of so-called atomic swaps.
title: Bridgeless atomic cross chain swaps

problem: Very few projects on Cardano bring NFT to life and provide real value to its owners.
solution: Giving mint users an NFT depends on how much that user contributes to the community. The higher the level the NFT owner will get, the more benefits.

title: Bringing MMORPG Gaming to Cardano!

title: Broaden open source wallet options

solution: By building Training Kits & more software tools with COTI ₳DA Pay, helping Cardano Hubs show the world we are the Blockchain for real-world business & increase ₳DA denominated ecosystem transactions

solution: Buying regenerative foods with ADA, sent through a smart contract % towards smallholder farmers to support livelihood, best farming practices and receive impact validation.

Using Ada coin.

solution: Our solution to Cardano concurrency leverages VRFs, off-chain communication, and on-chain infrastructure to heavily increase throughput. It ensures competing state transitions are not posted on-chain.
title: MLabs - Cardano Throughput Solution

problem: Making Blockfrost easily accessible to dApp developers as the default, regardless of all other technical choices, will help Blockfrost adoption grow first and foremost.
solution: MLabs has been working with IOG to build the Cardano Transaction Library (CTL), a framework for building Cardano transactions. We propose adding Blockfrost as an available query layer within CTL.
title: MLabs - CTL Blockfrost Backend

problem: In Cardano's growing ecosystem, we've seen an explosion of tools and techniques for building smart contracts. Developers can and will move much faster if equipped with excellent guides and examples.
solution: MLabs has worked with Cardano smart contracts for 15 months across multiple projects. We’re well-positioned to make direct contributions and work with maintainers to improve docs for everyone.
title: MLabs - Dev Documentation Drive

problem: To fully decentralize, the hardware needed to interact with Cardano should be minimal. Though some Cardano projects use embedded systems, best practices are underdeveloped.
solution: We are developing a secure and open-source software platform for embedded devices on Cardano blockchain. This applies to hardware wallets and other devices buildable using our primitives.
title: MLabs - Embedano (Embedded Devices)

problem: Plutarch v1 greatly reduces the requirements of implementing stateful dApps (DeFi). Yet, expanded functionality is needed for Cardano devs/auditors to fully leverage the dramatic gains of this eDSL.
solution: We will greatly expand the Plutarch feature set to improve efficiency and capability. There will be more powerful abstractions than before and a multi-backend solution for off-chain and on-chain use.
title: MLabs - Plutarch v2

problem: Ada adoption in Cameroon is significantly hindered by the fact that there is no exchange currently supporting easy transfer to local currency or mobile money except for scamming ones.
solution: Build a bridge DEX to facilitate the conversion between FCFA to ADA leveraging the opportunities offered by mobile money agencies.
title: Mobile Money Bridge & DEX

problem: Secure trading is not easily accessible for people limited to mobile devices, forcing them to use insecure trust-based escrows. Mobile accessibility is of utmost importance for ecosystem growth.
solution: We will design and develop a mobile version of Tent, allowing easier access to secure trading to a wider audience while providing a first-class user experience.
title: Mobile Multisig Live Asset Trading

problem: How can we motivate young students in the North East region of Ghana to get educated in the present and coming technologies?
solution: Set-up a premiere community hub in Nalerigu to offer students access to basic ICT training and services to compete with their peers in other regions and the globe at large.
title: Model ICT Hub

problem: Most SPOs use gLiveView to track the node status (requires access to the command line) or prometheus/graphana, where is lack of essencial data
solution: We are developing a client/server solution to track key parameters of the node/server and send notifications to a special node operator app
title: Monitoring tools for SPO

problem: The developer community in East Africa still needs to be built, incentivized and motivated to build on Cardano.
solution: There is need to build a the developer ecosystem that helps them to have a sense of community and a place they can share ideas
title: More Developers on Cardano

problem: The problem is that cross-chain security issues still occur frequently, and users are concerned about the safety of cross-chain assets.
solution: As the first cross-chain bridge built on Cardano, MicroChains is to provide more secure cross-chain solutions for multi-chain projects and users.
title: More secure cross-chain solutions

problem: Soil erosion is the cause of the degradation and fear of soil fauna and flora and is therefore one of the key elements of extreme disasters and climate change.
solution: Plant fast-growing, fertilizing trees in areas at risk of erosion and turn each tree into a dynamic NFTree, facilitating their protection, tracking, and expansion.
title: Mtidano: NFTrees 4 Erosion Control

problem: Cardano, like most blockchains, is currently isolated and only few solutions for bridges exist. Existing solutions are not extendable to new chains or require trust in its operators (can get hacked).
solution: We built Erdstall, a trust-less multi-chain L2 platform already targeting Ethereum. We plan to expand to Cardano (and many other chains later) and add true token bridge functionality (wrapped tokens).
title: Multi-chain token bridge

problem: In the absence of a liquidity pool between token X and Z current Cardano AMM protocols don't work. However, we could potentially perform a multi-hop swap between token X and Y and token Y and Z.
solution: We want to develop an implementation for multi-hop trading on Cardano.
title: Multi-hop swaps for more liquidity

problem: Tent allows 2 users to trade assets using a multi-sig transaction. We lack security and penetration tests, and code audits done by a third party to better guarantee user and platform security.
solution: Through the funding of this proposal, we will be able to perform all the security and penetration tests, and code audits done all by a third party, and implement any changes needed to improve security
title: Multi-sig Trading Audits & Security

problem: Current multisig experience is very cumbersome. Different blockchains implement it in various way. It is hard to keep track of DAO's/corporate's/group's funds when you have assets on multiple chains.
solution: We provide a unified multisig wallet, that supports multiple chains under one simple UI. It is the same user experience, regardless wither it is coin or token and what chain is it on.
title: Multichain multisig wallet

problem: There are no enough dRep resources which serve as a starting point for new members and existing members in multiple languages. These are lacking resources to provide active engagement contribution.
solution: Leverage existing Catalyst communities to create a 14 languages dRep hub with language ambassadors from Catalyst community to translate existing dRep resources and provide continuous dRep updates .
title: Multilingual dRep Resources

problem: Definitely, current NFT games CAN NOT take a penny from $220B market of nearly 4B players in the mainstream gaming industry because of their hate and wrong bias toward gamefi.
solution: Our community-built gaming platform will both satisfy the gaming experiences of 4 billion real gamers and thousand crypto investors with sustainable business models. Check out our one-page in f9 here
title: MULTIPLE THE VALUE OF $220B MARKET

problem: Two key obstacles to the mass adoption of Cardano are the inability for users to directly fund their wallets by credit card and the lack of multisig wallet functionality for shared treasuries.
solution: We will develop an overlay for existing Cardano wallets that provides a credit card payment gateway and a business vault with multisig wallet functionality for shared treasuries.
title: Multisig wallet with fiat on-ramp

problem: Secure multi-chain aggregators, interoperability protocols, & cross-chain swapping platforms connecting L1 solutions to both eUTXO and EVM compatible networks are non-existent in todays landscape.
solution: MultiSwap reimagines architectural & OpSec best practices, providing the fastest, most secure & feature complete solution on the market while encouraging TVL across Cardano native DeFi protocols.
title: MultiSwap (X-Chain Swaps by Ferrum)

problem: Stakeholders on traditional business models, don't have any impact on management in the ecosystems they live in. Building DAO food delivery app! We want to streamline decentralize management.
solution: Our solution is Decentralized Autonomous Organization delivery food app, by creating the necessary tools and voting statutes to direct future budgets, costs and rewards systems.
title: Munchy Go Delivery Food dApp DAO

problem: We Munchy Go Delivery Food dApp, want to cut costs for restaurants, increase couriers pay and save user pockets, on average restaurants pay to delivery food apps 20% to 30% fees.
solution: We will use smart contracts to decrease layers of inefficiency, improve business performance, integrating orders, cut costs, automate and simplify food on demand services.
title: "Munchy Go" Delivery Food dApp DAO

problem: In a world without libraries, it would be difficult to advance research and knowledge or to preserve for future generations the knowledge and heritage accumulated by humanity.
solution: As pathways to knowledge and culture, libraries occupy a decisive place in society. This library makes available in real time books in agronomic, environmental and technological sciences.
title: MY DIGITAL LIBRARY

solution:
My Identity

It is a web platform using blockchain to digitize education services in the Democratic Republic of Congo and provide teachers with decentralized digital identities.

problem: There is no ability to combine ‘real world’, positive social interactions with your unique experiences; all while creating a digital (web 3.0) presence in the process.
solution: There is no ability to combine ‘real world’, positive social interactions with your unique experiences; all while creating a digital (web 3.0) presence in the process.
title: MyUnbox

problem: No incentive for people to act as influencers and promoters for Catalyst. Unless they have a proposal they aren't motivated to evangelize.
solution: Create a native token to incentivize evangelists and influencers of Catalyst comprehensive onboarding process for kids to senior citizens
title: Native Token Incentivize Onboarding

solution: We benefit from a fabulous 4-billion-year-old legacy bequeathed by the Earth. 🌍 Let's bring this into consciousness with every transaction we do. With a fungible token on Cardano this can be done.

problem: In Africa, access to books and ebooks is severely limited. Numerous factors are at play against mass adoption of a reading culture which negatively affect all involved parties (authors, readers, etc).
solution: Create an NFT book library focused on promoting a reading culture in Africa starting in CMR. The platform will greatly expand and facilitate access to books as well as provide incentives to readers.

Current NFT holders "do not actually own the NFT". Because NFT information is still stored on a centralized server.

NFT doesn't have interoperability. So we can't build metaverse in the future
solution:
We create a dynamic NFT platform that can help NFT holders "really own NFT"

The platform also helps users to create interoperability NFTs. A user's NFT can contain multiple assets.

problem: Today, customer feedback is unreliable. Often public & shaming (-), it doesn't show accurate (overall) customers' sentiment to a brand. What if customer-created content could be private + compensated?
solution: NFT platform to record constructive consumer feedback/content; shared by people with brands; compensating you for useful & creative content (fund 6), now extended to professional creators (artists).
title: NFT 4 customer feedback - creators

problem: The blossoming NFT technology has seen poor adoption globally. The space demands easier ways for blockchain enthusisasts to own NFTs
solution: Pangaea Kingdom’s solution is to create an interactive play-for-fun-and-earn concept which is the Social-GameFi.
title: NFT BATTLE ROYAL GAME ON CARDANO

problem: By 2023, the world will have 1.11 billion people who read eBooks, but none of them own these digital books, and therefore there is no secondary market for eBooks or audiobooks.
solution: We're creating a marketplace for NFT eBooks and audiobooks. Readers can buy and sell. Authors and publishers get a % of the secondary sale in perpetuity. Readers earn $BOOK token as they read.
title: NFT Books - Book Token Platform

problem:
At the moment, there's no reliable way to transfer NFTs to or from Cardano.

The existing bridges are FT focused.

Cardano based NFTs are behind an Iron Curtain cut out from the world markets.
solution:
XP.Network connects > 16 chain mapping the contract logic, collection name & attributes.

We adapt the bridged assets to the standards of the target chain to be listed, displayed and traded like native
title: NFT Bridge to & from Cardano

problem: A lot of upcoming apps, wallets and marketplaces rely on collection stats/NFT data, however it is time consuming to gather and maintain it.
solution: We will develop a public api offering using our Jungle database which consists of all NFTs, full historic sales (even pre-sc era from cnft.io) to provide all necessary data points for projects to use.
title: NFT Data Public API

problem: Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) need more utility to drive long term engagement. As of yet there is no leading platform on Cardano that allows for NFTs to be staked and farmed in DeFi smart contracts.
solution: A platform that allows for owners and developers to create farms where users can stake multiple NFTs on an aesthetically pleasing interface whilst generating extrinsic rewards for each user.
title: NFT Farming on Cardano with Tangent

problem:
The film industry could be a very powerful ally in the mainstream adoption of blockchain tech, but they are understandably reluctant.

How do we get decision-makers interested?
solution: Build a platform for NFT film distribution and showcase a successful example of a blockchain-enabled solution to attract the attention of key players in the industry.
title: NFT Film Distribution Dapp&Showcase

problem:
Some endangered animals should be protected by all of us because the stability of our ecosystem depends on them.

Seriously endangered species such as: Giraffe, Elephant, Bonobos, PANGOLINS, etc.
solution: The creation of a web platform in partnership with the ICCN for the sale or auction of endangered animals from the fauna and flora of the Democratic Republic of the Congo in NFT format.
title: NFT for DRC Fauna and Flora

problem: Being able to directly own DAO treasury NFT assets requires a system that enables members to participate in a fair and representative distribution mechanism that currently doesn't exist.
solution: The mechanism presented here allows DAOs or any entity to be able to take NFT assets that they own, fractionalize them, and fairly distribute those fractions to their members.
title: NFT Fractionalization System

problem:
Cardano doesn't have a real marketplace for Gamefi on Cardano yet

The number of NFT games and gamers currently on Cardano is still not much

NFT games have the largest number of transactions on-chain.
solution:
We're connecting DarePlay (an NFT marketplace with over 50 games on Binance Smart Chain) to Cardano on Cardano's EVM.

We will also partner with NFT games on our marketplace to launch on Cardano.

problem:
The Cardano NFT community is working in silos on similar initiatives for tools and standards.

It needs an open space to network, connect ideas and projects and set standards collectively.
solution: The NFT Guild identifies common problems and needs, coordinates efforts, creates open spaces for discussions.
title: NFT Guild Operations

problem: NFT projects are businesses that require multiple people to come together to create the artworks, community and handle the technical aspects of minting, but there exists no platform for such hiring.
solution: An NFT job board that allows creators to post open positions for artists, community mods, developers and more.
title: NFT Job Board

problem: NFT buyers, sellers, lenders, and borrowers need to have the necessary tools and evaluation tools to make educated decisions on selling, lending, buying, and borrowing on NFTs.
solution:
The lending pond team will create and fine tune a vector machine using machine learning to mimic the price evaluation of a NFT broker.

  


The machine will also take into account floor price, traits, vol
title: NFT machine learning evaulation

challenge: F9: Catalyst Natives X Cardashift: Demonstrating and monetizing impact
problem: NFTs can establish new standards for the accountability of Non-Profit Organizations (NPOs). Gender Unicorns aims to be the first registered NFT-NPO to serve ESG goals via a new NFT economy
solution: Establish the legal framework & partnerships for Non-Profit NFT projects to register as NPOs. The NFT-NPOs will maximize their ESG impact while offering incentives / NFT gifts to their donors.

problem: NFT Tracking and Tax Reporting can be very complex & time-consuming
solution: CNFT Jungle Portfolio Tracker and Tax Reporting Tool will allow NFT investors to track key data about their NFTs from across various sources and provide guidance on tax reporting, all in one place.
title: NFT Portfolio & Tax reporting tool

problem: How can we ensure Cardano NFTs create real-world business value? Jpeg images of animated monkeys are all cool, but the real long-term value is in creating lucrative business opportunities.
solution: Rarety aims to build customizable use cases using a trade-able NFT paywall, built in-house, enabling creators to sell digital content behind a scarce and trade-able paywall.
title: NFT Powered Pay-Wall System

problem: Cardano at the time of writing this proposal has 56000+ policy IDs that represent collections of different utility, collectability and art with barely any collection having a working on-chain DAO.
solution: A tool to allow creators to use their NFTs as governance tokens to help inform the growth of their collections without paying for developmental costs of creating a working DAO from the ground up.
title: NFT powered Turnkey DAOs

problem: Cardano still lacks the NFT infrastructure to support play to earn games, NFT breeding, and NFT borrowing.
solution: The Lending Pond team will make a peer to peer NFT renting platform using smart contracts to support Cardano NFT projects and games in their in game economies.
title: NFT renting(by Lending Pond)

problem: Currently, Cardano applications are search-able based on token policy ID and name and do not search based on metadata characteristics specific to NFTs.
solution: We will develop an app to search metadata in the Cardano blockchain utilizing Cardano-node, Cardano db-sync, PostgreSQL, IPFS, and web tech.
title: NFT Search Engine on Cardano

problem: Artists have the gift and ability to create artwork but not websites to commercialize their art, and they struggle to find the right person to develop a customized website to represent them.
solution: An NFT Store builder will allow artists to create their store from the ground up in minutes with pre-built components and no coding knowledge.
title: NFT Store Builder

problem: Often the seller of a Cardano NFT does so to purchase another NFT from the same collection. This results in unnecessary fees & lost opportunities.
solution: A dapp showcasing the open-source NFT swapping smart contract templates we're developing. These will be accompanied by matching off-chain code, easy to adapt and implement by any Cardano NFT project.
title: NFT Swap Infrastructure Templates 2

problem: We need more real world uses for NFTs that have actual use and utility.
solution: We are building NFT's on Cardano into our Augmented Reality adventure platform that is playable anywhere outdoors on IOS/Android mobile devices.
title: NFT Use & Utility on AR Platforms

problem: NFT Valuation is very complex with risky outcomes, it requires multiple data points which are complicated to gather without having an already set database in place
solution: CNFT Jungle Valuation Tool will assess NFTs value for users using the Jungle Database which consists of: Full CNFT sales history for every asset and collection, rarity data, traits, listings and more.
title: NFT Valuation Public API

problem: Physically disabled persons (people with paralysis) are not able to include themselves in web 3 communities due to the lack of navigating ability and emotional uncertainty.
solution: Mouseware enables people with disabilities to control devices hands free with simple head movements. This product would enable persons with disabilities to generate income by creating like art, music.
title: NFTMarket for Disabled-Dextroverse

problem: Over the course of the past 6 months we have consistently seen 50-60% of our traffic coming from mobile devices who can't trade or mint on the store without the usage of a separate dApp.
solution: We want to create native mobile applications (iOS and Android) for JPG Store with deep linking technologies to allow a smoother trading and minting experience for people using mobile devices.
title: NFTs go Mobile

problem: IP Infringement is a big issue today. Take film tourism for example, over half the listings on sites like GetYourGuide do not give anything back to the original IP holders. We need a better solution.
solution: We propose a marketplace backed by a hassle-free IP agreement negotiation framework to create a place where IP holders and creators can freely collaborate without fear of copyright infringement.

problem: Most NGOs do not know the impact of their work because data collection is expensive, onerous, and time-consuming. Similarly, the sector lacks transparency over the impact it has.
solution: *Havuta provides a blockchain-based mobile app to help NGOs dramatically lower the costs of impact data collection for the programs they run; providing data for NGOs and transparency for donors.*

problem: To visualize real time data on a Smart Contract it is not quite easy. It requires Tech Knowledge on how to fetch data, store them and keep getting them updated and costs a lot for the business.
solution: Imagine, if the above problem can be solved by yourself at low-cost with just basic computer knowledge & without any infra costs. Reimagine data in your own way with few mouse clicks on Cardano chain
title: No Code Smart Contract Indexer

problem: Most songs go entirely unheard and sadly over 90% of music streams going to the top 1% of music creators who earn very little value from their creative work.
solution: Nodesound will usher in a new way of rewarding music creators for their work as we will give fans the ability to decide on what music is worth to them, in a fair, open and decentralized market.
title: Nodesound - Music On The Blockchain

problem: The world’s sustainability goals (SDGs, Climate, Green Economy, Finance 4.0) can arguably only be achieved on a global level through highly scalable projects with real, measurable impact.
solution: NOMICA has the ambition to be the leading provider for ESG products and for for the market place to become the main destination to buy NFT’s for these ESG products.
title: NOMICA Incentive Platform

problem: Trading collectable items through traditional avenues is costly, time-consuming and illiquid.
solution: We plan to build an NFT marketplace where the NFTs are backed by certified physical collectables. Our solution is to offer lower costs, easier access and greater liquidity.

problem: Most North Africans (Morocco, Algeria, Mauritania, Tunisia, Libya, Egypt, Sudan) native language is Arabic, many speak french but most Cardano materials are in English.
solution: Creation and animation of a community hub for the Arabic speaking community to drive awareness and adoption around Cardano in North Africa, mainly, weekly meeting, Discord server.

Developing a future store of value by protecting pure water and rare species.

  


Creating knowledge of nature.

  


Through gaming our goal is to increase and train cognitive capacities in all humans.

title: Online tools for generative artists

problem: Many developers like learning from examples, but they are hard to find for Plutus smart contracts.
solution: Build an open-source library that allows anyone to search, share, and get feedback on smart contracts.

solution: Open Source NFT analytics platform with free and open individual tool API integration for any organization or individual building on Cardano.

Token vesting is a vital component in the fundraising toolkit.

  


Cardano lacks an open and free self-service vesting standard for native tokens.

We will port our existing vesting dApp at app.unvest.io to support all native Cardano assets.

problem: Some DAOs can have a hard time to become sustainable and to improve this we need open source tools that can generate extra revenue.

Ease of online transactions while providing consumers with a selection of choices.

  


The platform will also promote the growth of small, medium and big business within the country.

  


A one stop shop.

problem: Connected vehicles require enhanced layers of security and data privacy. Current car-sharing solutions are centralized platforms.
solution: We aim to develop a Cardano Car sharing solution on the blockchain, guaranteeing privacy and security for the provided services.
title: PeakChain Car-Sharing Platform

title: PeakChain Cardano Car Wallet Device

problem: Connected vehicles require enhanced layers of security and data privacy. Current fleet management solutions are centralized platforms.
solution: We aim to develop a Cardano Fleet Management solution on the blockchain, guaranteeing privacy and security for the provided services.
title: PeakChain Fleet Management Platform

A privacy first app for :

•Analytics of trends and personalized recommendation systems

title: Perma-music rmNFT Marketplace

title: PetLove Social Media & Marketplace

solution: Providing a persistent RPG world where characters can persist with predefined tasks and projects that a player more oversees than controls.

prism. Enables proof of humanity KYC solutions.

solution: blockchain publication, decentralized education, & the write of human knowledge. We will push the growth & development of censorship resistant education with an open source decentralized web3 library.
title: The Alexandria Project Web3 Library

problem: Lack of a Cardano focused, hosted and structured events programme introducing artists, and catalysing multi chain and interoperable collaboration among NFT artists of all chains.
solution: The Art Suite events hosted globally, presenting Cardano NFTs to all artists, both from other blockchain platforms as well as those new to NFTs, for multi chain empowerment + sustainable impact.
title: The ArtSuite Multi-Chain NFT Events

problem: Web2 traps us with marginally-personalized experiences, wasting our time in searching for (and often missing) the experiences we truly value.
solution: A componentized marketplace builder with a fully customizable interface, allowing developers to offer app experiences based on user autonomous filtering and matching.
title: The DAM Marketplace

problem:
It is hard to find

1. A senior developer who is open to mentor young developers
2. A developer who is open to do some development gigs for enterprises and startups
solution: Listing platform for developers who are open to mentor or work on small gigs (paid or unpaid) on cardano to list their profile (Project links, Linkedin, Gitlab link, Summary, hourly rates etc)
title: The Developer List

problem: Cardano Green and Social Good projects need alternative fundraising options and the Cardano ecosystem needs more high quality open source projects.
solution: Continue to build out The Open Source Cardano Lottery for fundraising of Green and Social Good Cardano projects. All code is open source which contributes to the Cardano open source community.
title: The Open Source Cardano Lottery

problem: The Web3 barrier to entry is too high. The tech is too intimidating, the number of ways to contribute are too low, leaving 1000's of people on the sidelines trying to get into the game
solution:
The Newton Protocol is a decentralized, PaaS that

1. Takes care of the complex technical concerns for you
2. Incentivizes open-source contribution & innovation
3. Unlocks the value of Web3 for all stakeholders
title: The Platform as a Service for Web3

problem: Indigenious wisdom is being lost at an alarming rate in both Africa and further afield. Local communities lack the access to the technology that could help preserve their stories.
solution: The Story Bank provides a way to preserve the stories of our ancestors by going into local communities and bringing those stories on chain and ensuring they last for generations to come.
title: The Story Bank

challenge: F9: Catalyst Natives X Cardashift: Demonstrating and monetizing impact
problem: A key challenge in the WEB 3 space is that there is not a user-friendly, transparent way to invest towards impact driven businesses and track/verify their impact for support or through investments.
solution: Developing a platform/token for impact investing, directly connecting you to projects by tracking their impact, and evaluating their effectiveness over time with clear impact measurements.
title: The Sustainable Goals Token

problem: Particularly during the COVID-19 pandemic, one of the problems of the real estate sector as the dependence on physical meetings to conclude contracts stands out. Procedural difficulties
solution: The real estate market in the Democratic Republic of Congo seems to be entering a new phase of financial bubble. It is said to be linked to the shortage of properties on the real estate market.
title: The tokenization of real estate

problem: The widespread theft and counterfeiting of Name-Image-Likeness assets of athletes must be stopped, while enhancing their ability to monetize their digital identity and personal brand through tokens.
solution: A DApp to establish ownership of NIL assets by linking NFTs with DIDs to: (1) provide verifiable rights transfer of authentic NIL assets, and (2) enable legal enforcement of rights.
title: There's no We without Me

problem: Student entrepreneurs in universities, specially in developing countries, when evaluating possibilities for funding have a limited scope to apply for, and are unaware of new alternatives.
solution: Write a Masters thesis (MSc Finance) on Catalyst as a decentralized VC solution ideally suited for developing country entrepreneurs, which can be used to divulge the platform in academic environments.
title: Thesis on Catalyst Decentralized VC

problem:
Falsification - fraud

Currently the classic production of concert, show or soccer tickets allows platforms with dubious practices to make a second market a source of potential duplication of tickets.
solution: With blockchain Cardano everything will happen electronically.A digital nominative ticket is purchased,which will allow you to have a unique identifier for each ticket.
title: Ticketing system in Africa

problem: There's a lack of access to resources and education for African student athletes, artists and creatives on monetization, entrepreneurship, and ownership.
solution: TiDi Nation (TN) KPIs can be identified: impression, cost effective, and customer life-time return. TN will on-board, educate and teach student athletes how to monetize using the Cardano ecosystem.
title: TiDi Nation - Grow Africa

problem: An explosion of protocols, DApps, DEXs, NFTs and other artifacts of blockchain has led to an expanded attack surface for threat actors seeking to capitalize on victims in these ecosystems.
solution: We propose the build-out of an open source Threat Intelligence Platform (TIP) for the Cardano community supplemented by portal access, a training module, and a YouTube video on why TIPs are important.
title: TIP For Collaboration

problem: Cardano doesn't have a framework that makes it easy to implement Token Gating to provide access control and personalized user experiences to visitors to websites and DApps
solution: We build a DApp that lets admin add information and generate a script that that can be copied to their Website/DApp to provide TokenGating capability. This proposal follows a successful pilot.
title: Token Gating on Cardano with CNFTs

problem: Using tokens to access content/services or subscriptions requires creating your code to issue/manage/send tokens. Larger projects require UTxOs optimization for the continuous issuance of tokens.
solution: To provide a powerful tool for issuing and managing tokens for projects of any scale. In addition, simplify tokenization in the form of access to content, services, and subscriptions.
title: Token Maker + GoFunNFT

problem: NFT projects lack utility for their holders. Staking is one potential utility they can offer, but It is challenging to implement because it requires specialized technical knowledge.
solution: We intend to offer a Smart Contract based Staking as a Service for projects wishing to provide staking to their holders. This will be a turn-key solution, focusing on ease of use and usability.
title: Token Staking Platform

challenge: F9: Catalyst Natives X Cardashift: Demonstrating and monetizing impact
problem: Worldwide, there is still no ecosystem that creates incentives, creates conditions in which the world of work is valued and promoted.
solution: To create a worldwide token system which provides incentives for all involved in the world of work.
title: token system for the world of work

challenge: F9: Catalyst Natives X Cardashift: Demonstrating and monetizing impact
problem: 8 out of 10 workers in Africa are involved in informal employment and their contribution to the economy is not measured and valued.
solution: ERS is an approach to continuous professional training that measures “employment impact”. It is a digital tool capable of connecting informal workers with job opportunities by valorising their skills.
title: Tokenising employment - ERS

problem: Crowdsourcing initiatives often have contributors with no remuneration or that do not have the tools to present a unified vision, as well as they see communities getting isolated.
solution: Goodwall will develop a token-based in-app economy providing positive reinforcement whereby users are recognized and rewarded for their progress/work and have the possibility to exchange the tokens.
title: Tokenization: Creator Economy

challenge: F9: Catalyst Natives X Cardashift: Demonstrating and monetizing impact
problem: Indie film makers have a hard time financing their film projects especially if these are not exactly viewed as commercially viable. The film can be a vehicle to show that Cardano can tokenize assets.
solution: To solve the problem of finding financing for non-commercial indie films, we propose the use of cryptotokens to tokenize these as assets.
title: Tokenized tech indie drama film

problem: Access to tertiary education responding to labor market need is limited and lacks appropriate financing mechanisms.
solution: We will do a proof of concept for tokenizing income share agreements on emerging markets.
title: Tokenizing Income Share - PoC

problem: Access to tertiary education (post-secondary school) responding to labor market needs is limited and lacks appropriate financing mechanisms.
solution: We will research the Income Share Agreement (ISA) value chain in emerging markets; and how to tokenize real-world educational assets.
title: Tokenizing Income Share - Use Cases

problem: Enterprises have a high entry point for providing custom content and features to holders of tokens, in a secure way.
solution: A utility portal as a service for enterprises. Fully editable project hubs accessed by wallet login containing specific tokens.
title: TokenPerkz: Unlockable Utility Hub

problem: Wide token distribution is fundamental for successful community-driven projects and decentralization. It is difficult, however, for projects to widely distribute tokens on both Cardano and Ergo.
solution: TosiDrop is a token distribution platform on Cardano and Ergo that allows the wide distribution of project tokens to their supporters and community members in a seamless manner.
title: TosiDrop Cross-chain Development

problem: DAOs rely on a governance and voting mechanism to allow community members to contribute to the direction of a protocol. TosiDrop is implementing a seamless on-chain voting mechanism.
solution: Through TosiDrop, projects are able to implement votes to decide on the direction of a project. On-chain voting will allow projects to seamlessly host governance events.
title: TosiDrop DAO Governance Platform

problem: There is currently not a dApp that allows projects to distribute tokens in a permissionless manner via smart contracts. With TosiDrop, anyone can distribute their tokens entirely on smart contracts.
solution: Token distribution platforms today are centralized, causing these platforms to be gatekeepers for which projects can and cannot be distributed. With TosiDrop, anyone can distribute their token.
title: TosiDrop dApp and Audit

problem: Difficulty following, keeping up to date and tracking favorite wallet addresses with NFTs Minted, Bought and Sold on the Cardano blockchain in a simple way, in real time and receiving notifications.
solution: Follow ADA Wallets and Get Notified when they Mint, Buy or Sell Cardano NFTs. Track wallets that interest you: influencers, whales, traders... Always be the first alerted via Discord, Mail & Web Push.
title: Track Wallets: Notify Mint/Buy NFTs

problem: Tent was created to be a universal tool that anyone could utilize to safely trade Native Cardano Assets. For now, the product has been implemented in English, leaving non-English speakers vulnerable.
solution: We will develop a multilanguage functionality for Tent, making it easier for people from all over the world to trade Native Cardano Assets from Wallet to Wallet in their native language.
title: Trading Tent: Multi-language

problem: It is hard to understand and learn how to be a good dRep in isolation, there is a lack of community and collaboration in this space to ask questions and learn together to critically look at proposals.
solution: Cardano4Climate will become a dRep as a community and use our weekly meetings, Discord and Telegram channels, to explore how to be a good dRep through an experiential process and community decisions.
title: Training dReps with Cardano4Climate

problem: The transaction editor has no secure key management and key storage, all keys are on the filesystem. Users improvise safety by working on air-gapped machines.
solution: Enhance the Cardano transaction editor with an interface to hardware devices for key storage and transaction signing.
title: Transaction Editor Hardware wallet

problem: The transaction editor supports the Alonzo Hard Fork yet with the newest features coming with Vasil it requires many updates.
solution: This is mostly a maintenance work. But the Transaction editor needs to incorporate the changes in behavior, outputs and features arriving with the new cardano-node for the hardfork era.
title: Transaction Editor post Vasil HF

problem: The determination of the solvency of customers for obtaining bank credit does not yet take into consideration the various operations (transactions of all kinds) carried out on blockchains.
solution: Provide users and banks with a tool to leverage operations performed on the Cardano platform in the process of computation of credit score to improve the user's solvency level and financial inclusion.
title: Transactions for Bank credits score

challenge: F9: Grow East Asia, Grow Cardano
problem: Without support for Asian languages in Eternl, we exclude ~1.45b non-English speakers from the Cardano system. While Asia accounts for 52% of global growth in tech-company revenues in the last decade.
solution: Translate Eternl to 6 Asian languages with professional translation services and help from our community.
title: Translate Eternl

problem: It is not straight forward for non-English speaking users to onboard into the Cardano ecosystem.
solution: We built Pool Peek Mobile to assist users with the staking process. We will translate the app into Swahili (~200 million African speakers).
title: Translate Pool Peek Mobile: Swahili

challenge: F9: Grow East Asia, Grow Cardano
problem: Cardano Vietnam community needs a trust worthy place to discuss, update, look up and analyze information about all projects on the Cardano, and provide technical support in time.
solution: Tre Viet's Telegram channel has long been a trusted address of the Vietnamese community in supporting project information on the Cardano ecosystem.
title: Tre Viet - VN support channel

problem: Cardano needs games that are timeless, adaptable, customizable, and collaborative. Most games now have limited game play and have a specific art style that does not appeal to a wide audience.
solution: Treasure Chain is an art network where users can assign rules about how their NFTs can interact with each other. With these rule templates the NFTs can act like a giant neural network of art.
title: TREASURE CHAIN - An NFT Art Network

problem: Funded proposers have difficulty managing their budgets effectively and documenting their transactions transparently. There is no project management support available. This impacts proposal delivery.
solution: Treasury Guild advisory service will manage budgets & document transactions so that everything is accessible and transparent. We will also provide Project Management support to ease proposal delivery
title: Treasury Guild Advisory Service

problem: Tribal identity systems, in place for millennia, are not yet recognised by states/institutions creating national DIDs, excluding indigenous population’s pre-colonial norms, rules, rights & sovereignty
solution: Using AtalaPrism SDK, integrate DID wallet features in Āhau, the tribal identity DApp made for, by, with Maori, indigenous people of Aotearoa (New Zealand) to enable issuance of verifiable credentials
title: Tribal DIDs=Indigenous Sovereignty

problem: Although some first DEXes are emerging, the Cardano ecosystem is lacking a fully trust-less, non-custodial off-chain and open-source NFT marketplace.
solution: We built Erdstall, a trust-less multi-chain L2 platform currently deployed on Ethereum. We plan to expand it to Cardano and build a trust-less, non-custodial L2 NFT marketplace on Erdstall.
title: Trust-less non-custodial L2 NFT DEX

challenge: F9: Grow East Asia, Grow Cardano
problem: The main challenges come up and most facing by growth and development country are trust and transparent journalism information which free from propaganda, hatespeech, false information, etc.
solution: Development of Trust, Transparent and Hatespeech free News Portal with integration between AI-NLP Model and Blockchain Technology as part of Journalism Trust Initiative and Reporter Without Border.
title: Trust & Transparent News Portal

problem: Most blockchain games in development target hardcore gamers ignoring the fact that the majority of the audience are casual players and fail to convey the advantages of digital ownership to users.
solution: Make clear the value of digital ownership enabled by NFTs and blockchain through a concept anyone can understand and connect with: owning, interacting and caring for a digital pet in a fun, unique way

problem: Like with all new products there is a fear of the unknown, and Blockfrost is no exception.
solution: We are currently building a cardano wallet on blockfrost, and we would make a live tutorial of all our activities to help people understadn how easy it is to use Blockfrost
title: Tutorial on Building a wallet

problem: There's a lack of compelling and entertaining media projects to educate African audiences about Web3, Cardano and Project Catalyst.
solution: awo.AI is a TV series featuring Cardano that entertains African audiences while educating them about the blockchain and Project Catalyst.
title: TV Series ft. Cardano: awo.AI

problem: A mobile wallet that supports all features and is user-friendly, secure, and fast, connects with Ledger, and Trezor; is a must for users. Cardano lacks mobile wallet options for greater adoption
solution: Create a user-friendly UI/UX non-custodial Cardano Wallet mobile app that enables users to transact, connect with DApps, engage in seamless staking, browse Assets/NFT gallery, and do a lot more.
title: Typhon Wallet Mobile App

problem: Africa is a target for most innovative businesses that are integrating crypto use. How do we easily locate businesses adopting crypto use in Africa?
solution: Develop crypto use map DAO on Cardano blockchain that would organize, locate and map credible business locations with integrated crypto use/adoption.
title: Ubuntu Crypto Use Map DAO

problem: Lack of access to financial credit is deepening the woes of informal businesses in Africa due to a lack of collateral. How can we provide credit to businesses in the informal sector?
solution: Use cooperative smart contracts to provide financial collateral-free credit to informal sector businesses in Africa while leveraging the Cardano blockchain.
title: Ubuntu Informal Biz Credit DApp

problem: Informal Businesses (Biz) dominate Africa's economy, yet are financially excluded, how do we provide identity & financial inclusiveness for informal biz (SMEs) in Africa?
solution: Build DApp with triple-entry accounting on Cardano Blockchain to provide identity & financial inclusiveness for informal businesses in Africa.
title: Ubuntu Informal Biz Reg& Accounting

problem:
We live in a world where Banks and third parties control which company, institution or individual receives loans.

We lack a decentralised trust system for people to lend to deserving companies.
solution: We are creating a platform where underwriters, small lenders and smart companies will be able to help and trust each other through decentralised smart contracts.
title: Uncollateralized crypto loans

problem: We need Dreps representing diverse regions and cultures. Those Dreps living in underprivileged countries will find difficult to achieve saturation, creating inefficiencies in the governance.
solution: To allow these Dreps to achieve saturation (1% of the total stake) we will provide a campaigning funds and office, so their voices and platforms can be heard abroad, reaching whales and main countries
title: Underprivileged DREPS Campaigning

problem: Need for blockchain global standard for Unified Public Transport Payment Gateway allowing secured & fair transactions using smart contracts.
solution: To develop a decentralized Payment Gateway using DLT and DApps on Cardano employing smart contracts for payment transactions across parties.
title: Unified Transport Payment Gateway

problem: There is not enough creative ways that connect between chains and unite them to grow mass adoption
solution: A weekly caricature showing the importance of collaborations and dependency between chains for mass market adoption, and that also have educational purposes for other Blockchains
title: United Caricature 2

problem: The problem that United Media is here to fix is the lack of production, content creation, and documenting the crypto community. Bringing the point of views of those who are working on the blockchain
solution: United Media is going to go out into the field to find builders of the blockchain. The business that wants to do business using crypto currency. We will make a schedule and contact list of those folks
title: United Media BlockChain Community

problem: The United Nations lack understanding on how blockchain can be used for achieving the SDGs and how to build partnerships with blockchain communities and startups.
solution: A knowledge sharing series within the UN ecosystem on using blockchain to solve the Grand Challenges and creating tangible cross-sector partnerships
title: United Nations Blockchain4Impact

problem: Cardano is not very accessible to Game Developers, there are barely any games running on Cardano and even less Game-Focused tools.
solution: We want to create a Unity Plugin which will be released on the Unity Asset Store for free, that allows for easy management of NFTs and NFT Minting in-game.
title: Unity Game Engine NFT Plugin

problem: So far, there is no decentralized system that would support distributed R&D of new chemical compounds. Progress in molecular chemistry is slowed down by the cumbersome structure of academic papers.
solution: We will create a single extensible library of chemical compound models and a platform for working with them based on our molecular simulator and the Cardano network.
title: Universal Chemical Library

problem: Queen's University, a prominent engineering school in Canada known for its plethora of student-run design teams, does not have a blockchain based design team and are missing this opportunity.
solution:
We will create a *Queen's Blockchain Design Team* where students collaborate on Cardano Projects.

We will create and make publicly available onboarding & tutorial videos to help students new to Cardano.
title: University Design Team

problem:
> Interest in blockchain is growing, yet Unreal lacks Cardano integration. 

  



> Projects use other chains, develop custom solutions, or lose interest.
solution: Develop a Professional, Community Driven, & Easy to Use Unreal Engine Plugin powered by Blockfrost.
title: Unreal Engine Integration

problem:
> Unreal Developers desiring Cardano adoption are few & isolated.

  



> Nowhere Unreal specific to share, resources, discuss tools, or engage with Community.
solution: > Nurture a community of Unreal developers working on Cardano & toolmakers interested in reaching an audience.
title: Unreal Engine on Cardano Community

problem: Unsung creatives are challenged with counterfeits, inadequate artwork provenance, extended time to market and inadequate financial services.
solution: Ada NFT Marketplace with a DAO can facilitate reduced counterfeiting, better artwork provenance and access to DeFi and faster time to market
title: Unsung NFT Marketplace with DeFi

problem: African tech entrepreneurs don't have enough support on their projects to get involved in the Cardano blockchain
solution: Celebrating the innovation of young Congolese entrepreneurs by organizing a competition which rewards the 3 best innovative ideas in NTICs, especially in Cardano Blockchain.
title: UPDEV CHALLENGE

problem: Typhonjs is a pure-js Cardano wallet library. With the impending Vasil hard fork, developers will need Vasil compatibility in order to create more efficient smart contracts and DApps.
solution: Upgrade Typhon Js library to support changes of the upcoming Vasil hard fork, mainly Reference scripts, Plutus V2 support, and inline Plutus Datum
title: Upgrade Cardano wallet js for Vasil

problem: Food insecurity is a global crisis. Supply chain issues are making the problem more acute. Localizing food production fights this directly.
solution: Develop a dApp that helps micro urban farms to operate and expand, while making it easy for community members to order produce from them.
title: Urban Farmer dApp Phase II

problem: There does not exist a trust-chain from the migrant community sending remittances to regions where sanctions and flashpoints are common, and fear of intangibility of assets are unacceptable.
solution: American branch incentivizes migrants already sending remittances to switch to this trust-chain, which is zero cost. The other end, in Kenya, has KYC built in by the Bank of Kenya and is an OpenAPI.
title: US-Kenya Based WOT Remittance Chain

problem: Concurrency with UTXOs is a tricky problem that is difficult to solve and adds to transaction load unnecessarily.
solution: I propose creating a math model and script that developers could use to structure their transactions to minimize the number of transactions and maximize the potential power of transactions.
title: UTXO Optimizer and Scheduler

problem: Many people staking ADA for passive income but still want to increase their assets when the market fluctuates. However, withdrawing from the wallet to the exchange, from the exchange....
solution: V2target is an application that helps Cardano users to process transactions on the crypto market in two directions. They can both increase their profits and also increase the amount of ADA they own...
title: V2target-Dual target for ADA holder

problem: The problem of treatment and care taking into account hereditary factors of patients, vaccination and maternity. Reduction in infant mortality and inappropriate treatment
solution: Management of the prenatal and preschool consultation process (vaccines), detection of the medical history of the ancestors for appropriate treatment. Management of the medical file by family.
title: Vaccines and Family Medical Record

problem: Keeping track of your wallet(s) value and profit/loss can take a lot of time. And setting up a tax report to comply with your country's regulations is even more time-consuming.
solution: Track your wallet's real-time worth by combining owned, listed, and staked NFTs & coins with their current prices. And being able to export a tax report to comply with your region’s tax regulations.
title: Valuation & Tax Reporting Tool

challenge: F9: Grow East Asia, Grow Cardano
problem:
Knowledge and news about Cardano are mostly in English,it is difficult to reach Japanese community, affecting the expansion of Cardano...

Knowledge about Cardano and blockchain are very large
solution:
We will add more knowledge articles into library in phase 2

Community user can comment and participate in building library content.

Some new will be create to make content of library more diverse
title: Vcoincheck Library (Phase 2)

problem: There are many projects related to knowledge sharing but do not create two-way interaction, education and lack of vision to build a diverse educational platform or product...
solution: Vcoincheck.io is a platform or product related to sharing, training and educating about Cardano and blockchain knowledge. The project has had 5 proposals to be funded in funds 7 and 8.
title: Vcoincheck-Share(Knowledge) to earn

challenge: F9: Catalyst Natives X Cardashift: Demonstrating and monetizing impact
problem: The VC ecosystem is clunky and missing parts of a broader utility landscape. While use is promising for employers, edu institutions, and VC owners, structure and governance concerns constrain use.
solution: Using validation (Cmrt\*) contracts rather than current processes to support VCs through SSI principles in a coherent system will allow employers and other receivers to utilize VCs according to need.

challenge: F9: Catalyst Natives X Cardashift: Demonstrating and monetizing impact
problem: There are not enough tokenomics models which focus on advancing SDGs through tokenizing and incentivizing behavioural change.
solution: ImpactScope is designing easy-to-deploy tokenomics models which encourage and reward sustainable behaviour and impact verification.
title: Verify2Earn

problem: Creators and artists which are new to the cardano ecosystem have a lack on understanding the protocoll, it's characteristics and how native tokens work on cardano.
solution: To help these people i plan to create tutorial videos for cardano-tools.io which explain the features and give the according background informations about the protocol and other systems.
title: Video tutorial for cardano-tools.io

problem: Haskell is the base programing language of Cardano's Smart Contracts. A lot of developers are very interested in building projects on Cardano but there are not any Haskell courses in Vietnamese
solution: We created a Haskell course in Vietnamese to help Vietnamese developers build projects on Cardano. This course will give developers understand how to code by Haskell basically
title: Vietnamese Haskell Course

problem: One major problem in the blockchain ecosystem is that the females are being left behind in these innovation steps. How do we build female competence to participate in the Cardano ecosystem?
solution: Launch a training program to target at least 100 female students, graduates, or young entrepreneurs to become virtual assistants in Project catalyst.
title: Virtual Assistant

problem: There is a shortage of developers developing on Cardano globally, specifically the Asian region, and there is still a lot of room for builders to build products in the Cardano ecosystem.
solution: A virtual hackathon to inspire builders. Hackathons bring new and existing developers across the world together, building on Cardano and introducing a flow of high-yield projects into the ecosystem.
title: Virtual Hackathon for Dev Education

problem: NFT adoption is a huge driver for blockchain growth. Unfortunately, Cardano does not have proper high-speed analytics platforms like in Ethereum to support it's NFT user base.
solution: We will build an NFT analytics platform as there is a lack of it in the CNFT space. Icy Tools (ETH) , has 2.5million daily site visits which speaks for the demand such a product has.
title: Visio: Cardano NFT Analytics Tools

problem: In order for blockchain voting to be relevant to real-world use cases, there must be a way to map wallets to real-world individuals.
solution: We plan to research existing DID solutions such as Atala PRISM and IAMX, and integrate one or more of them into Voteaire to allow ballots which are limited to authenticated individuals.
title: Voteaire Decentralized IDs

problem: DAOs based on Cardano lack easy-to-use tools for automatically distributing funds based on a governance vote.
solution: Integrate a smart contract or native script solution into the existing Voteaire platform to allow locked funds to be unlocked by the outcome of a ballot
title: Voteaire Escrow Smart Contract

problem: Most DApps mint their token, then use this token to distribute rewards to existing holders. This causes a downward trend in token value. Income should be generated not minted and distributed to users.
solution: Build a second layer solution to our DApp that allows users to access yield generated from the swapping of tokens on the DEX. Users stake their token and are distributed fees accrued from the DEX.
title: VyFinance DEx and Bar

problem: Traditional web2 fitness platforms are centralized with self-serving designs that prevent broader community engagement outside of specific company ecosystems.
solution: Create a unifying community platform for cyclists to share, earn, celebrate and connect with riders on a local and global level. Provide new incentives to drive and inspire cycling in the community.
title: W3:RIDE : The future of cycling

problem: There is a shortage of online courses targeted at Haskell developers with a focus on building with Cardano.
solution: Create an online, self-paced, modular learning environment for Haskell and Plutus developers to improve their skills, in a multitude of languages.
title: Wada Academy for Haskell Devs

problem:
A growing number of Catalyst projects require support, but may not have the funding or requirements for a full-time hire.

  


+ There is a pool of talent that is currently underserved and underutilized.
solution: Develop and launch an internship program that caters to students and recent graduates in Africa. This program will consist of onboarding, training, then connecting them with Catalyst projects.
title: Wada Internships->African Students

problem:
A lack of integration between dApps and products means that projects are often working in silos.

  


These projects miss out on the benefit of shared user bases and seamless user experiences.
solution: Create a platform marketplace for new Cardano dApps and products to host their solutions on and gain access to new markets.
title: Wada Product Integrations

challenge: F9: Catalyst Natives X Cardashift: Demonstrating and monetizing impact
problem: Most impact orgs like Wada struggle financially due to improper value capture as an investment vehicle. This leads to unrealized benefits of impact ventures and monetary loss for potential investors
solution: Templating a valuation method for Wada's Web3 Education DAO will ensure that we maximize impact funding & investment, plus create tooling for other community orgs in the Cardano ecosystem to utilize
title: Wada Web3 Education DAO Valuation

problem: WAL-CLI is a great tool, but it can be of greater utility for the developer community if it is expanded into an Identity wallet API service.
solution: Expand WAL-CLI implementation to create an API-based identity wallet service
title: WAL-API Identity Wallet Service

problem: The issue credential protocol required to issue credentials from WAL-CLI instances to RootsWallet App needs to be implemented.
solution: Expand WAL-CLI implementation to include the protocols required for credential issuance between WAL-CLI and RootsWallet
title: WAL-CLI Issue Credential Protocol

problem: There is no wallet add-on for the game engine client in Cardano that suits the requirement of Miverse in long-term development.
solution: We develop an open-source wallet add-on for game engine clients.
title: WALLET ADD-ONS FOR GAME ENGINE

problem: All dapps need to have easy connection to all third party non-custodial wallets. While CIP-30 exists, implementing an easy to use layer on top of this with React would be useful to other dev teams.
solution: We will integrate our the platform with all third party Cardano Wallets including eternl, gero yoroi, nami, and typhon wallet. Additional wallets will be supported as they come online.
